# 🌅 **Helios – Ultra-Light Performance Modpack for Minecraft 1.21.8 (Fabric)**
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4a3a271b7e5e444ad49fe5d4d726156557ae16cc_0.webp)

**Helios** is an ultra-light, next-generation performance modpack designed to deliver **maximum FPS**, **reduced RAM usage**, and **smoother world generation** on any device — PC, laptop, or mobile via **PojavLauncher**. Unlike heavy renderer replacements, Helios uses **modern, modular optimizations** that preserve full compatibility and keep the game visually vanilla. Helios is built and tested directly on mobile hardware to ensure **stability**, **efficiency**, and **zero artificial restrictions**.

---
## ⚡ **Key Features**
- **Massive FPS boost** powered by Lithium, VMP, C2ME, FerriteCore, and other modern optimizers.
- **Fully mobile-friendly** — no renderer rewrites, no crashes, full PojavLauncher support.
- **Ultra-lightweight** — only essential libraries and performance mods, no visual changes.
- **Faster chunk loading** through multithreading and improved memory management.
- **GPU-level enhancements** with GpuMod and GpuTape.
- **Instant resource pack loading** with QuickPack.
- **100% vanilla-compatible** — works on any server, including pure vanilla.
---

## 🔸 **Why Helios Is Better Than Traditional Performance Packs**
Most performance modpacks rely on outdated renderer replacements that break mobile compatibility, cause crashes, reduce mod support, and introduce unnecessary compromises. Helios avoids all of that. By using **modern, actively maintained optimizers**, it delivers: higher FPS, smoother frame pacing, lower RAM usage, full cross-device compatibility. Even low-end phones feel the improvement immediately.
